title: 2026 air-transport Scope 3 and WTT QA controls

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Air-transport factors in this section are Scope 3 only.
They cover direct and WTT emissions for business travel and air freight.
Business-travel factors apply to individuals flying for work purposes.
Air WTT factors cover upstream extraction, refining and transport of aviation fuel before take-off.
Air-freight factors are provided per tonne-km of goods transported.
There were no major air-transport methodological changes in the 2026 update.
The methodology uses the EUROCONTROL small emitters tool to estimate fuel burn and CO2 for representative flights.
The EUROCONTROL tool is regularly updated, validated with airline fuel-consumption data, and covers a broad aircraft range.
CAA statistics provide aircraft, route, seating, load-factor and passenger-km inputs used in domestic, short-haul and long-haul averages.
Freight carried on passenger services is accounted for and materially affects long-haul passenger factors.
